Teacher Eyes Only

Solutions for Level E: Logbook Aggregation.

Concept Overview

  • Aggregation: The Player may have a Logbook (it can exist independently), unlike Composition (Inventory) which dies with the player.
  • Dependency Injection: We create the Logbook outside and pass it in (`attach_logbook`).

Common Misconceptions

1. `self.logbook` initialization

It must start as `None` in `__init__`. We only set it when `attach_logbook` is called.

2. Defensive Programming

In `record_event`, students must check `if self.logbook is None`. If they don't, the game will crash if they try to log something before obtaining the device.

Solution Code

logbook.py

class Logbook:
    def __init__(self):
        self._entries = []

    def add_entry(self, entry):
        self._entries.append(entry)

    def list_entries(self):
        return list(self._entries)  # Copy

player.py (additions)

    def attach_logbook(self, logbook):
        self.logbook = logbook

    def record_event(self, entry):
        if self.logbook is None:
            return "No logbook attached."
            
        self.logbook.add_entry(entry)
        return "Logbook updated."
